 ▝▝   ▝▝   /Users/romankrysinski/work/repositories/hq


❯ Write a 120-word poem about the sea, no tools.

● The Sea

  The sea keeps no calendar, only tides,
  slow grey breathing under moon and wind.
  It carries ships and secrets on its back,
  and folds the evening light into its skin.

  At dawn the gulls rehearse their ragged hymns,
  the harbour stirs, the ropes and rigging creak.
  A fisherman reads weather in the swell
